name: Hasegawa Misaki
source: Daughter of a rich successful business man. Believes proper etiquette is everything. Unable to relate to Yasuhiro as some one as poor background and believing him not to have common sense. Her main goal is to raise him as proper upper class person understanding the finer things in life.
translation: Daughter of a rich successful business man. Believes proper etiquette is everything. Unable to relate to Yasuhiro as some one as poor background and believing him not to have common sense. Her main goal is to raise him as proper upper class person understanding the finer things in life.
